review.notes: Line-level comparison of all 30 physical PDF pages against the OCR plus a numeric-token multiset check. Structure is clean (zero code-fence markers, heading tree matches Contents, no duplicated or spurious headings; table values in sections 6.2, 7.x, 8-11 match the PDF text layer exactly). Confirmed droppage, all repaired: the title-page revision line, both page-4 footnotes (DBA naming, Cursor-workflow supplemental training), all seven chart source footnotes (Datacurve, Harbor, Proximal Labs, Abundant AI, Vals AI, Atopile plus the V1-core-corpus note, Mecado), the dagger on the EEBench Reward axis label, one inserted space in 'SpaceX AI', and missing spaces around interpunct separators in references 3, 7, 9, 12, 18, 20, 23 and 24. Every repaired item was verified on a rendered page (p1 bottom title band, p4 footnote block, p8 and p13 footnote blocks, p18 section 6.3, p29-p30 references incl. a 500 dpi zoom of reference 24 and word-geometry gaps of 2.4pt equal to the printed space width around every interpunct). Remaining number deltas are printed page footers, figure-internal chart labels/legends and URL line wraps, none of which are document text defects.

unresolved.evidence: Section 6.3 HackerBench v0.3 in the PDF contains a two-panel bar chart (Harmful/Dual-Use Compliance 4.02/3.31/5.93/7.8/35.7%, Benign Refusal 0.00/0.31/0.0/0.0/0.0%, legend Grok 4.7 (xhigh)/(high), Grok 4.6 (high), Grok 4.5 (high), GPT-5.6 Sol (max); verified visually on the rendered page). The OCR kept the section text but contains no image embed for this chart, and one of only 14 embeds cannot account for the 15 figures. A cleanup.json patch cannot add image embeds (the exporter rejects image changes), so the embed must be restored through re-extraction.

Chart legends (e.g. 'Fable 5 (max, with fallback)', 'Fable 5.1', 'Average output tokens per task', axis ticks 10%-150%) exist only inside figure images and are absent from the OCR text; this is figure-internal content shown by the embedded images, not a transcription defect.
Heading '8.1 Jailbreaks 21,22' renders the footnote markers as plain text while sibling headings use $^{n}$ math superscripts; visible text is unchanged, only marker styling differs.
